title: Test speed: move or slim the over-60 s debug tests in camcraft-motion lib

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P5
labels.description: Agent surface and tooling keep up with what shipped

body:
`motion suites: lib` sets the floor of the batch gate and the debug release phase.
It took 726 s on Hetzner ccx43 (`8643d9bb7`, `--test-threads=2`).
It took 287 s on the post-merge runner (`3a240b7fb`, `--test-threads=6`).

We timed all 434 active debug tests in `camcraft-motion --lib` on a 16-core Linux host.
The 434 tests took 4,594.3 s of total CPU time.
Only 14 tests over 60 s took 4,022.9 s (87.6% of the binary).
The other 420 tests took 571.4 s (12.4%).

The 14 slow tests live in three files:
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_tests.rs` (11 tests over 60 s):
  - `triangle_and_wide_to_narrow_neck_are_cleared` (687.3 s)
  - `pocket_with_island_is_cleared_without_crossing_or_excess_rest` (671.9 s)
  - `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes` (474.4 s)
  - `ring_round_island_is_cleared_with_closed_lane` (401.2 s)
  - `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width` (333.7 s)
  - `custom_parameters_reach_parallel_and_closed_lane_layouts` (332.2 s)
  - `custom_return_feed_is_emitted_by_production_parallel_lanes_and_cleanup` (260.3 s)
  - `corner_cleanup_reduces_34x16_rest_to_at_most_hsm_rest` (168.6 s)
  - `the_opened_bore_leaves_no_post_at_the_lane_start` (139.8 s)
  - `the_pocket_face_is_cleared_inside_its_region_under_the_engagement_limit` (76.2 s)
  - `without_lift_room_the_returns_retract_and_a_plunge_entry_is_said_unread` (72.5 s)
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/tests.rs` (2 tests):
  - `the_slot_and_its_32_nm_twin_decide_the_same_way` (181.2 s; heavy-lane `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations` already tests 32 nm)
  - `a_channel_is_grown_as_one_spiral_that_never_crosses` (152.3 s)
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm_ring.rs` (1 test):
  - `an_air_plan_over_the_load_bound_is_refused_by_name` (71.3 s)

Sibling `l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` (`adaptive_troch_tests.rs:331`) already uses `#[ignore = "heavy lane: ..."]`.
Three tests in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/air_rings_tests.rs` (lines 76, 87, 102) recompute `ring_plan()` three times (35.3 s, 42.7 s, 43.3 s).

What to do:
1. Move the full-pocket `check_cleared` tests and slow slot-growth tests to `#[ignore = "heavy lane: ..."]` per `AGENTS.md` ("Testing").
2. Keep slim debug checks that test the same laws under 10 s where needed.
3. Split each moved two-case `check_cleared` test into separate single-case `#[test]` functions so `motion heavy: lib` stays parallel.
4. Shrink the 60x40 and 60x50 regions in `custom_parameters_reach_parallel_and_closed_lane_layouts` and `custom_return_feed_is_emitted_by_production_parallel_lanes_and_cleanup`.
5. Use a smaller pocket for the `max_engagement: 10.0` refusal check in `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width`.
6. Cache `ring_plan()` in `air_rings_tests.rs` with `std::sync::OnceLock` so all three tests share one run.
7. Keep the `#[test]` count of `camcraft-motion --lib` equal or higher. Keep every assertion across the debug and heavy lanes.

Done means:
- No active debug test in `motion suites: lib` exceeds 60 s.
- The `#[test]` count of `camcraft-motion --lib` stays equal or higher.
- Every moved test passes under `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --lib -- --ignored`.
- `motion suites: lib` finishes under 90 s in debug on the gate.

Part of #2556
